Request a Demo The breakthrough in month-end close is here The AI revolution meets corporate finance. We’ve spent 25 years building AI-driven products as executives in NASDAQ-traded AI-first companies. We've seen firsthand how teams struggle with outdated processes. At Apprentice, we believe AI is finally ready to automate the repetitive, mundane aspects of work by learning and mimicking human decision-making. Your AI-Powered Team Member ‍ You don’t need another dashboard or platform to learn and spend days customizing your needs. With AI deeply embedded in your workflows, Apprentice unlocks previously impossible insights — identifying slow reconciliation processes, spotting anomalies in financial statements, and surfacing inefficiencies before they impact your bottom line. The finance team of the future isn’t just faster—it’s smarter.
